AUTONOMY: reassess the backlog and PREPARE (JSON only at work/packages/, never in queue/, never submitted) the next package: if the operator authorisation is still absent the next package is the corresponding authorised-implementation package (WP-R5-003R re-run) marked requires_operator_authorisation.
